divisions.title: The Quest for Meaning
divisions.theme: Vanity of vanities, all is vanity
divisions.summary: The Teacher examines pleasure, wisdom, toil, and achievement, finding all meaningless under the sun.

divisions.title: Time, Justice, and God
divisions.theme: A time for everything under heaven
divisions.summary: Seasons of life, oppression observed, the folly of vows, and the fear of God as anchor.

divisions.title: Wisdom's Limits
divisions.theme: Who knows what is good for man?
divisions.summary: Wealth without enjoyment, wisdom better than folly yet limited, injustice and mystery persist.

divisions.title: Life, Death & the Creator
divisions.theme: Remember your Creator in the days of your youth
divisions.summary: Enjoy life while you can, wisdom and folly contrasted, youth fades, dust returns, fear God and keep his commandments.
